videos.title: Welcome to Qudemo
videos.question: Intro
videos.answer: Hey there — great to meet you! I'm Jazeem, one of the co-founders here at Qudemo. Before I show you anything, I'd love to understand a bit about how you currently run your product demos. Are they mostly live calls, or do you send pre-recorded videos to prospects?

nextQuestions.text: No, I would like to quickly see what Qudemo does

videos.subtitle: https://storage.googleapis.com/qudemo-videos/subtitles/video_intro.vtt

videos.title: Discovery — live demo workflow
videos.question: We mostly do live demos
videos.answer: Got it — so your team runs live calls. Out of curiosity, how often do prospects actually make it to the call stage? A lot of SaaS teams tell us scheduling and no-shows are big pain points.

nextQuestions.text: Yes, no-shows are common and it's hard to scale
No, our show-up rate is pretty good

videos.subtitle: https://storage.googleapis.com/qudemo-videos/subtitles/video_discovery_live.vtt

videos.title: Discovery — recorded demo workflow
videos.question: We use pre-recorded videos
videos.answer: Nice — that's efficient. When you send those out, do prospects usually reply with follow-up questions, or do they tend to ghost after watching?

nextQuestions.text: They ask a lot of questions, we spend time replying manually

videos.subtitle: https://storage.googleapis.com/qudemo-videos/subtitles/video_discovery_recorded.vtt

videos.title: Pain — too many manual follow-ups
videos.question: They ask a lot of questions manually
videos.answer: Exactly what we've heard from other SaaS teams — prospects want quick answers, but it's time-consuming to reply to each one. That's where Qudemo steps in: it lets your demo video actually respond to those questions for you, 24/7.

nextQuestions.text: Interesting, how does it actually do that?
So it's like a chatbot on top of my video?

videos.subtitle: https://storage.googleapis.com/qudemo-videos/subtitles/video_pain_interactive.vtt

videos.title: Pain — low engagement or ghosting
videos.question: Most prospects don't respond
videos.answer: Yeah, that's super common. People get busy — and a static video doesn't pull them in. What Qudemo does is turn your demo into an interactive experience, so viewers can ask questions mid-watch and stay engaged all the way through.

nextQuestions.text: That sounds cool — can you show me?
How hard is it to set up?
